open_obligations: Actual IO.Process.spawn/loader/Linux argv provenance and input/output memory ownership remain open.
C stops at its first NUL; logical byte-list rejection does not assert rejection of bytes following that terminator.
Native main-loop ordering, sequential stores and later failure mutation are not proved by the pure layout.
Parent positivity, signed-PID range, getppid identity, optional digest validity and all remaining policy/controller checks remain explicit.
Sequential source semantics excludes interfering memory writers; deployed store atomicity is not established.
Translation faithfulness, imported logical-model review, all sixteen original native/Linux obligations, compiler/runtime/linker/loader correspondence and hardware channels remain open.
